color.note: One light theme. AiGRI has no dark mode.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on white, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3, cream and sun (14.94, 13.72, 12.79, 14.07 and 9.86 to 1). Fills ink buttons, card-ink, toasts and the sat tags. Focus ring on light grounds.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and descriptions on white, surface-2, surface-3 and cream (8.22, 7.55, 7.03 and 7.74 to 1). Also the pending pill ink.

tokens.name: muted-2
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (timestamps, table meta, axis ticks, placeholders) on white (4.71) and surface-1 (4.52) at 15px and up. Does NOT reach 4.5 on surface-2 (4.33) or surface-3 (4.03): on those grounds use muted. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons only (2.94 on white, exempt from contrast). Never for live content.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Field green. Links, eyebrows, active nav icon, progress fills and selected states on white, surface-2 and cream (4.99, 4.58 and 4.70). Fill of card-green and the wallet balance with white text (4.99). Logo rows.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Illustration and data only: chart series 1, parcel fills, meters. White on leaf is 3.68 to 1, which fails 4.5 for text, so never put text on it and never use it as text. For text or a filled control use green (#557945, 4.99 with white). Never in the logo.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Primary call to action fill (ink label, 9.86) and the logo sun. One per view. Never a status, chart series, icon or highlight. 1.51 on white, so never text.

tokens.name: sun-press
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the sun button. Ink label stays on it.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Warm highlight surface: selected choice, top policy, consent block, drag-over upload. Ink text on it (14.07).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background and cards on surface-2. Ink, muted and green text read on it. Label colour on green, ink and alert-strong fills.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Zebra rows in dense tables. Ink and muted text read on it.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, inputs and chips on white. Ink and muted text read on it; muted-2 does not.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover or pressed on surface-2, pending pills, skeleton, cite chips. Ink and muted text read on it.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Progress, stepper and timeline tracks, chart baselines. A fill, never a text ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour: 3px, 3px offset. Set to white inside ink, green, toast and photo surfaces.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Approved, Paid, Active, Issued text and icon on ok-bg (6.44) and white.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Solid ground for ok pills, banners and selected table rows. Text on it: ok or ink.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of pending pills (muted text, 7.03).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Pre-checked and satellite-reading text and icon on info-bg (5.71) and white.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Solid ground for info pills and banners. Text on it: info.

tokens.name: need
tokens.usage: Info requested, Needs action text and icon on need-bg (6.30). Amber, distinct from sun; never a button fill.

tokens.name: need-bg
tokens.usage: Solid ground for need pills, banners and flagged table rows. Text on it: need or ink.

tokens.name: denied
tokens.usage: Denied, Failed and input-error text and icon on denied-bg (6.03) and white (7.27).

tokens.name: denied-bg
tokens.usage: Solid ground for denied pills, banners, invalid inputs and the error state. Text on it: denied.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Hazard text and icon on alert-bg (5.93). Threshold lines in charts. Fill of the one strong hazard banner with white text (7.03).

tokens.name: alert-bg
tokens.usage: Solid ground for alert pills and banners. Text on it: alert.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map base land and satellite frame ground. Graphic only.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Rivers, sea and permanent water on maps. Graphic only.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Map roads, 2px strokes. Graphic only.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Flood extent and rain series. 6.77 on white as a graphic mark.

tokens.name: parcel
tokens.usage: Insured parcel fill. Same value as leaf; graphic only, no text on it.

tokens.name: parcel-risk
tokens.usage: Parcel in a forecast hazard area, chart series 4. 3.35 on map-land: a graphic, always paired with a label or legend.

tokens.name: parcel-off
tokens.usage: Uninsured or outside-policy parcel. Graphic only.

styles.name: num-xl
styles.usage: Wallet balance and approved payout. Tabular numerals. 44px at 600px and below.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per page. ink on white.

styles.name: num-l
styles.usage: KPI values. Tabular numerals, never counted up.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: AiGRI drafts the claim. You confirm. The adjuster decides.
styles.usage: Page intro in muted, 640px wide at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The adjuster decides within 14 days of a complete claim.
styles.usage: Body, inputs and buttons. Never below 17px.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps and context in muted-2, on white only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and table headers in muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow in green, 8px above a title.
